title: Cloze Review (2026)
intro: Relationship CRM popular with real-estate and advisors, with Pro through Platinum annual per-user plans and a 14-day trial. This review covers pricing posture, CRM capabilities, limitations, and fit based on first-party research — not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Cloze overall score 6.8/10 from equal-weight CRM criteria. Pro $17, Silver $21, Gold $29, Platinum $42 per user/mo billed annually. 14-day trial.
verdict: Cloze: Choose Cloze when relationship/real-estate CRM with automatic people timelines is the priority. Scores reflect first-party research as of 2026-08-16 — not hands-on product testing.
